# TeaFloww — Full Information & Catalog Manifest

> Direct-from-origin single-estate orthodox teas harvested in Darjeeling, Assam, Kangra, and Nilgiri. Graded, cupped, and vacuum-sealed at origin in Siliguri, West Bengal, India.

## Organization
- Brand Name: TeaFloww
- Legal Entity: Nirva

- Provenance Policy: Never fabricate reviews, inventory scarcity, certifications, provenance, or shipping promises. All teas are 100% single-estate or truthfully disclosed blends.

- Fast 24–48h dispatch across India via Blue Dart and Delhivery.
